notice.title: Uploading happens in two stages
notice.body: First the file travels from your machine to the server — this depends on your connection speed and is shown on the progress bar. Do not leave the page during this stage or the upload will be cut off. Then the OCR server processes the pages in the background (approx. 2–3 pages/min) — at that point you can leave freely and return later, your progress is saved.

cancelConfirm: Are you sure? The upload will be cancelled and all data deleted.

errors.uploadStalled: Upload stalled — the connection dropped. The part already sent was lost; please try again.
errors.fileTooLarge: File is too large (max 500 MB). For very large files, upload as individual images.
errors.invalidPdf: Invalid PDF — file cannot be read

replaceWork.label: Replace existing work
replaceWork.warning: Replacement will delete all existing pages and replace them with new ones.
